Fall 2020 Class Schedule

There are three different types of modes of instruction: Fully Online, Hybrid, and In-Person (definitions linked). For Fall 2020, the majority of courses will be offered fully online, as aligned with the California State University (CSU) system, and through a campus-wide model and plan, called SJSU Adapt. Read the May 12 campus message for more information.

Per the CSU Chancellor Office's (CO) approval, a limited number of classes that cannot be fully delivered fully online will be delivered in-person or through hybrid modes of instruction. This will be done with rigorous standards of safety and welfare. 

Subject/Global Notes

Subject notes are notes for specific course subject codes or global notes. These notes identify general reminders for courses. See subject notes for under the following subjects: BIOL, CCS, CHAD, CHIN, CMPE, FLED, FORL, FREN, GERM, HEBR, INFO, ITAL, JOUR, JPN, MICR, PHYS, PORT, RTVF, RUSS, SPAN, TA, TAG, TECH, URBP, and VIET.

Class Notes

Real-time class listings, including textbook and course information, are found at one.sjsu.edu by searching for 'Class Search' in the Search Box.

Some classes have multiple class notes, but this website only displays the first class note. A full list of class notes can be found in the Class Search and clicking on the class section title. 

If the class note indicates that the class has multiple meeting patterns, please review in your MySJSU the courses additional meeting patterns dates and times - only one meeting pattern is included in this schedule.
